Title: Marketplace Page - Page Load
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://testifysolutions.net/marketplace/
2. Wait for page load
3. Verify page title
Expected Result:
- Page loads within 3 seconds
- Page title contains 'Marketplace'
- No 404 or 500 errors
- Main content visible
- Header and footer loaded

Title: Marketplace - Service Listings Display
Steps:
1. Scroll through service listings
2. Count number of services displayed
3. Verify each listing has required info
Expected Result:
- Multiple services listed (at least 3-5 visible)
- Each service shows: Title, Description, Price, Provider
- Services organized in grid or list
- Images or icons for each service (optional)
- Clear visual hierarchy

Title: Marketplace - Service Categories
Steps:
1. Locate category filter or navigation
2. Verify all categories are listed
3. Click on each category
4. Verify filtering works
Expected Result:
- Categories visible: 'All Services', 'Testing', 'QA', 'Automation', etc.
- Clicking category filters services
- Service count updates per category
- 'All' shows all services
- Active category highlighted

Title: Marketplace - Search Functionality
Steps:
1. Locate search box
2. Enter search term: 'manual testing'
3. Verify results filter
4. Try another search: 'automation'
5. Clear search
Expected Result:
- Search box prominently placed
- Results filter as you type (or after submit)
- Relevant services shown
- Search is case-insensitive
- Clear/reset button works
- No results message if no matches

Title: Marketplace - Service Detail View
Steps:
1. Click on a service listing
2. Verify detail page or modal opens
3. Review all information displayed
Expected Result:
- Detail view opens (new page or modal)
- Full service description visible
- Pricing clearly stated
- Service provider info shown
- Features/deliverables listed
- Estimated delivery time shown
- CTA button: 'Purchase' or 'Request Service'

Title: Marketplace - Pricing Display
Steps:
1. Review pricing for each service
2. Verify currency and format
3. Check for tiered pricing (if applicable)
Expected Result:
- Price displayed clearly for each service
- Currency symbol: $ (USD) or SOL (Solana)
- Format: '$99.00' or '5 SOL'
- Tiered pricing explained if applicable
- 'Starting at' vs 'Fixed price' clear
- No hidden fees mentioned

Title: Marketplace - Service Purchase Flow
Preconditions:
- Logged in (or guest checkout available)
- Service selected
Steps:
1. Click 'Purchase' or 'Buy Now' on service
2. Review order summary
3. Proceed to payment
4. Complete checkout
Expected Result:
- Order summary shows: Service, Price, Provider
- Checkout flow initiated
- Payment options available (crypto/traditional)
- Confirmation page after purchase
- Confirmation email sent
- Order added to user dashboard (if logged in)

Title: Marketplace - Web3 Wallet Connection
Preconditions:
- Marketplace page loaded
- Web3 wallet (Phantom, MetaMask) installed
Steps:
1. Click 'Connect Wallet' button
2. Authorize wallet connection
3. Verify wallet address displayed
4. Check SOL balance shows (if applicable)
Expected Result:
- Wallet connection prompt appears
- User can select wallet type
- Connection successful message
- Wallet address displayed (truncated): '7xK...3mP'
- User remains connected during session
- Disconnect option available

Title: Marketplace - Solana Payment Processing
Preconditions:
- Wallet connected
- Service selected for purchase
- SOL balance sufficient
Steps:
1. Proceed to purchase service with SOL
2. Confirm transaction in wallet
3. Wait for blockchain confirmation
4. Verify purchase confirmation
Expected Result:
- Transaction details shown: Amount in SOL, recipient address
- Gas fees displayed
- User confirms in wallet (Phantom/MetaMask)
- Transaction processes on Solana blockchain
- Confirmation within 1-2 seconds (Solana speed)
- Service access granted after confirmation

Title: Marketplace - Escrow System Display
Steps:
1. Review purchase details
2. Verify escrow information is displayed
3. Check escrow terms
Expected Result:
- Escrow explained: 'Payment held until service delivered'
- Terms clearly stated: conditions for release
- Timeline shown: 'Funds released after 7 days or upon approval'
- Dispute process mentioned
- Trust badge or indicator

Title: Marketplace - Service Provider Profile
Steps:
1. Click on service provider name
2. Verify provider profile page loads
3. Review profile information
Expected Result:
- Provider profile opens
- Information shown: Name, Bio, Rating, Reviews
- Services offered by provider listed
- Contact option available
- Verification badge (if applicable)
- Join date or experience level

Title: Marketplace - Provider Ratings and Reviews
Preconditions: - Provider profile or service detail open
Steps:
1. Locate ratings section
2. Verify star rating or score
3. Read individual reviews
4. Check review authenticity indicators
Expected Result:
- Overall rating displayed: '4.8/5' or '5 stars'
- Number of reviews: '(23 reviews)'
- Individual reviews show: Reviewer name, date, rating, comment
- Recent reviews prioritized
- No fake or spam reviews visible
- Verified purchase badge (optional)

Title: Marketplace - Leave a Review
Preconditions:
- User has purchased and received service
- Logged in
Steps:
1. Navigate to completed order
2. Click 'Leave a Review'
3. Rate service (1-5 stars)
4. Write review text
5. Submit review
Expected Result:
- Review form opens
- Star rating selector (1-5 stars)
- Text area for comments
- Character limit shown (e.g., 500 chars)
- Submit button functional
- Review appears after moderation/immediately
- Confirmation message

Title: Marketplace - Service Filtering by Price
Steps:
1. Locate price filter
2. Set price range: $0-$100
3. Verify results update
4. Adjust range: $100-$500
5. Clear filter
Expected Result:
- Price filter control visible (slider or input)
- Services filter to match range
- Service count updates
- Multiple ranges can be tested
- Reset/clear filter button works
- Filter persists during session

Title: Marketplace - Service Filtering by Delivery Time
Steps:
1. Locate delivery time filter
2. Select '24 hours' or 'Same day'
3. Verify filtering
4. Test other time options
Expected Result:
- Delivery time options: '24 hours', '1-3 days', '1 week+', etc.
- Services filter accordingly
- Estimated delivery time shown on listings
- Filter can be combined with others
- Clear filter option

Title: Marketplace - Sort Services
Steps:
1. Locate sort dropdown
2. Select 'Price: Low to High'
3. Verify services re-order
4. Test other sort options
Expected Result:
- Sort options: Price (Low/High), Rating, Newest, Popular
- Services re-order immediately
- Sort applies to filtered results
- Current sort option highlighted
- Default sort shown on page load

Title: Marketplace - Pagination or Infinite Scroll
Preconditions:
- Marketplace page loaded
- More services than fit on screen
Steps:
1. Scroll to bottom of service listings
2. Verify more services load OR pagination controls appear
3. Navigate to next page (if paginated)
Expected Result:
- If infinite scroll: More services load automatically
- If paginated: 'Next', page numbers, 'Previous' visible
- Smooth loading (no jank)
- User position preserved
- Total page count shown (if paginated): 'Page 1 of 5'

Title: Marketplace - Account Dashboard Access
Steps:
1. Click on account/profile icon
2. Navigate to dashboard
3. Verify sections are visible
Expected Result:
- Dashboard accessible from marketplace
- Sections: Orders, Purchases, Favorites, Wallet
- Order history shows past purchases
- Active orders shown with status
- Easy navigation back to marketplace

Title: Marketplace - Favorite/Save Services
Preconditions:
- User logged in
- Marketplace page loaded
Steps:
1. Hover over service listing
2. Click heart/star icon to favorite
3. Navigate to favorites section
4. Verify service is saved
5. Remove from favorites
Expected Result:
- Favorite icon visible on hover or always visible
- Icon toggles: empty → filled
- Service added to Favorites list
- Favorites persist across sessions
- Easy to remove from favorites
- Favorites accessible from dashboard

Title: Marketplace - Service Inquiry/Message Provider
Preconditions:
- Service detail page open
- User logged in
Steps:
1. Click 'Contact Provider' or 'Ask a Question'
2. Write message in form
3. Send message
4. Verify delivery
Expected Result:
- Contact form or messaging interface opens
- User can write message
- Character limit if applicable
- Message sends successfully
- Confirmation: 'Message sent'
- Provider receives notification
- Message thread accessible in dashboard

Title: Marketplace - Terms of Service Agreement
Steps:
1. Proceed to checkout
2. Verify Terms of Service acceptance
3. Read terms (if linked)
4. Accept and proceed
Expected Result:
- ToS agreement required before first purchase
- Checkbox: 'I agree to Terms of Service'
- Terms linked (opens in new tab or modal)
- Cannot proceed without acceptance
- Acceptance recorded
- Date of acceptance logged

Title: Marketplace - Dispute Resolution Process
Preconditions:
- Service delivered but issue exists
- User logged in
Steps:
1. Navigate to order in dashboard
2. Click 'Report Issue' or 'Dispute'
3. Fill out dispute form
4. Submit dispute
5. Verify case opened
Expected Result:
- Dispute option available within timeframe (e.g., 7 days)
- Dispute form: Issue type, Description, Evidence upload
- Submit button functional
- Dispute case ID generated
- Email confirmation sent
- Provider notified
- Escrow funds held until resolution

Title: Marketplace - Service Refund Request
Preconditions:
- Service not delivered or unsatisfactory
- Within refund window
Steps:
1. Navigate to order
2. Click 'Request Refund'
3. Select reason
4. Submit request
5. Monitor status
Expected Result:
- Refund button visible within policy window
- Refund reasons: 'Not delivered', 'Unsatisfactory', 'Wrong service'
- Form submission succeeds
- Refund request pending review
- Status updates in dashboard
- Refund processed to original payment method/wallet

Title: Marketplace - Transaction History
Preconditions:
- User logged in
- Multiple purchases made
Steps:
1. Navigate to account dashboard
2. Open 'Transaction History' or 'Orders'
3. Verify all transactions listed
Expected Result:
- All purchases listed chronologically
- Each entry shows: Date, Service, Amount, Status
- Status indicators: Completed, Pending, Disputed, Refunded
- Transaction IDs displayed
- Blockchain transaction links (for SOL payments)
- Downloadable receipts

Title: Marketplace - Blockchain Transaction Verification
Steps:
1. Complete purchase with SOL
2. Locate transaction ID in confirmation
3. Click transaction ID link
4. Verify on Solana Explorer
Expected Result:
- Transaction ID (signature) provided
- Link to Solana Explorer (solscan.io or solanaexplorer.com)
- Transaction details visible: Amount, timestamp, block, status
- Confirmation count shown
- No failed transactions (unless intentional test)

Title: Marketplace - Smart Contract Interaction
Steps:
1. Initiate escrow transaction
2. Inspect smart contract interaction
3. Verify contract address is correct
4. Check for proper authorization
Expected Result:
- Smart contract address verified (match official docs)
- Contract is audited (verify audit report availability)
- User approves specific actions only
- No unlimited allowances granted
- Events emitted correctly
- Gas fees reasonable

Title: Marketplace - Wallet Disconnect
Steps:
1. Click 'Disconnect Wallet' button
2. Verify wallet disconnects
3. Attempt actions requiring wallet
4. Reconnect wallet
Expected Result:
- Disconnect button visible when connected
- Wallet disconnects immediately
- Wallet address no longer displayed
- Actions requiring wallet show 'Connect Wallet' prompt
- User can reconnect smoothly
- Session data cleared

Title: Marketplace - Multi-Wallet Support
Steps:
1. Click 'Connect Wallet'
2. Verify wallet options appear
3. Select different wallets
4. Test each wallet connection
Expected Result:
- Wallet selection modal shows available wallets
- Supported wallets: Phantom, MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, WalletConnect
- Each wallet connects successfully
- User can switch wallets
- Previous connection remembered (optional)

Title: Marketplace - Insufficient Funds Handling
Preconditions:
- Wallet connected
- SOL balance < service price
Steps:
1. Attempt to purchase service
2. Proceed to payment
3. Confirm transaction
Expected Result:
- Error message: 'Insufficient funds'
- Transaction fails gracefully
- User prompted to add funds
- Link to buy SOL (if helpful)
- No partial payment processed
- User can retry after adding funds

Title: Marketplace - Network Congestion Handling
Preconditions: - Solana network congested (simulate or wait for high traffic)
Steps:
1. Initiate payment during congestion
2. Monitor transaction status
3. Verify user is informed
Expected Result:
- Transaction may take longer (still fast compared to other chains)
- Status indicator: 'Processing transaction...'
- User informed of delay
- Transaction completes or fails with clear message
- No stuck transactions
- Retry option if failed

Title: Marketplace - Service Provider Onboarding
Preconditions: - User wants to become service provider
Steps:
1. Locate 'Become a Provider' or 'Sell Services' link
2. Fill out application form
3. Submit application
4. Verify confirmation
Expected Result:
- Clear CTA to become provider
- Application form: Name, Email, Services offered, Experience, Portfolio
- KYC requirements stated (if any)
- Submission confirmation
- Review timeline communicated: 'We'll review in 3-5 days'
- Follow-up email sent

Title: Marketplace - Service Listing Creation
Preconditions:
- User is approved provider
- Logged in
Steps:
1. Navigate to provider dashboard
2. Click 'Create New Service'
3. Fill out service details: Title, Description, Price, Delivery time
4. Upload images/assets
5. Publish service
Expected Result:
- Service creation form intuitive
- Required fields marked
- Rich text editor for description
- Image upload: PNG, JPG, max 5MB
- Price in USD and/or SOL
- Preview option
- Publish button saves and lists service
- Service goes live immediately or after review

Title: Marketplace - Provider Earnings Dashboard
Steps:
1. Login as provider
2. Navigate to earnings section
3. Verify financial data
Expected Result:
- Earnings overview: Total earned, Pending, Available
- Transaction list with dates and amounts
- Withdrawal/payout option
- Fee breakdown: Platform fee (%), Net earnings
- Charts or graphs (optional)
- Export data (CSV)

Title: Marketplace - Payout/Withdrawal Request
Steps:
1. Click 'Withdraw' or 'Request Payout'
2. Enter amount
3. Select payout method (crypto wallet or bank)
4. Confirm withdrawal
Expected Result:
- Withdrawal form: Amount field, Payout method selector
- Minimum withdrawal amount stated
- Processing time communicated: '1-3 business days' or 'Instant for crypto'
- Confirmation required
- Withdrawal processed
- Email confirmation sent
- Balance updates

Title: Marketplace - Search No Results
Steps:
1. Search for nonsense term: 'xyzabc123'
2. Verify no results message
Expected Result:
- 'No services found' message displayed
- Helpful suggestions: 'Try different keywords' or 'Browse all services'
- Search box remains visible for new search
- Link back to all services
- No error messages (404)

Title: Marketplace - Mobile Responsive Layout
Steps:
1. Load marketplace on mobile
2. Browse services
3. Test filters and search
4. Attempt purchase
Expected Result:
- Service listings stack vertically
- Images scale appropriately
- Filters accessible (drawer or accordion)
- Search box usable
- Wallet connection works on mobile
- Purchase flow functional
- No horizontal scrolling

Title: Marketplace - Accessibility Compliance
Steps:
1. Navigate marketplace with keyboard only
2. Tab through all elements
3. Use screen reader to read content
4. Check color contrast
Expected Result:
- All interactive elements keyboard accessible
- Focus indicators visible
- Screen reader announces service titles, prices, buttons
- Color contrast meets WCAG AA
- Images have alt text
- Forms have labels
- No focus traps

Title: Marketplace - Service Image Optimization
Steps:
1. Inspect service images
2. Check file sizes and formats
3. Verify lazy loading
Expected Result:
- Images compressed (WebP format preferred)
- File sizes reasonable: <200KB each
- Lazy loading implemented (images load as user scrolls)
- Thumbnails used in listings, full-size on detail view
- No CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)

Title: Marketplace - Page Load Performance
Steps:
1. Open DevTools
2. Navigate to marketplace
3. Measure load time, FCP, LCP
Expected Result:
- Page loads in under 3 seconds on 4G
- First Contentful Paint (FCP) < 1.8s
- Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) < 2.5s
- Time to Interactive (TTI) < 3.5s
- Lighthouse score > 90

Title: Marketplace - SEO Optimization
Steps:
1. Inspect page source
2. Check meta tags
3. Verify structured data
Expected Result:
- Title tag: 'Marketplace - On-Demand QA Services | Testify Labs'
- Meta description compelling and < 160 chars
- H1 tag: 'QA Services Marketplace'
- Service listings have schema.org markup (Product or Service)
- Canonical URL set
- Open Graph tags for social sharing

Title: Marketplace - Service URL Structure
Steps:
1. Click on service
2. Verify URL structure
3. Test direct navigation with URL
Expected Result:
- URLs are clean: /marketplace/manual-testing-service
- No query parameters for service IDs: NOT /marketplace?id=123
- URLs are shareable
- Direct navigation works (deep linking)
- Breadcrumbs or back button functional

Title: Marketplace - Error Handling 404
Steps:
1. Navigate to invalid service URL: /marketplace/non-existent-service
2. Verify 404 handling
Expected Result:
- Custom 404 page displayed
- 404 page maintains site branding
- Helpful message: 'Service not found'
- Link back to marketplace
- Search box to find other services
- No stack trace or technical errors

Title: Marketplace - Error Handling API Failure
Steps:
1. Load marketplace with API failure
2. Verify error handling
Expected Result:
- Error message: 'Unable to load services. Please try again.'
- Retry button provided
- Page doesn't break completely
- Fallback UI shown (skeleton or placeholder)
- Error logged for debugging
- User not stuck

Title: Marketplace - Browser Compatibility
Steps:
1. Test marketplace on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge
2. Verify core functionality
3. Test wallet connections
Expected Result:
- Marketplace works on all major browsers
- Web3 features work (wallet connection)
- Layout consistent across browsers
- Performance acceptable
- Known issues documented (e.g., Safari Web3 limitations)
